heading: PON Core Axiom & Pathway
content: PON Axiom: NOTIFY, DON'T POLL. Pathway: State Mutation -> Fact Delta -> Evaluate Affected Premises Only -> Condition Evaluation -> Rule Activation -> ActionIntent Emission.

heading: PON Polling Prohibition & Determinism
content: Polling loops are strictly prohibited across reactive components. Notification ordering, idempotence, duplicate suppression, and cancellation must be governed by explicit deterministic policy.

heading: STC Coeffects & Effects
content: Spatial Coeffects define declared dependencies required from environment. Temporal Effects define mutations attributable to an owner that must register an inverse when applied.

heading: Cordis Teardown & Lifecycle Unwind
content: Deactivation unwinds registered effects in strict reverse order of activation. Dependencies activate before dependents; dependents deactivate before dependencies.

heading: Authority Boundary Architecture
content: Natural Language -> LLM Interpreter -> CandidateIntent -> [AUTHORITY BOUNDARY] -> Deterministic Validator -> ValidatedIntent -> Deterministic Resolver -> StateDiff -> GameState.

heading: CandidateIntent Validation Rules
content: Missing verbs, unknown entities, ambiguous targets, or invented fields are rejected. Authority-leak attempts (e.g. LLM outputting success: true) are stripped or rejected.

heading: State Replay & Immutability
content: GameState transitions strictly via apply(GameState_before, StateDiff). Rejected intents leave GameState byte-for-byte unchanged. Pure deterministic execution with zero runtime LLMs.

heading: RPG World: KHAYN // ABHEL : DYSKORDIA
content: Setting blends Salvador street mythology, cyberdecks, constellation networks, and occult factions. Synthetic data pipeline generates dialogue proposals for the deterministic core.

heading: Pi SDK createAgentSession Seam
content: The official @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent v0.84.3 SDK exports createAgentSession(). session.subscribe() returns an explicit () => void unsubscription closure.

heading: mountKadPon & Cordis Lifecycle Hook
content: mountKadPon(ctx, session) binds session.subscribe() unsubscription to ctx.on('dispose'). Translates queue_update events into typed KadNotification objects.

heading: Pi Post-Dispose Silence & Provenance
content: Disposing the Cordis context stops all event handling. Subsequent session events cause zero reaction. Local installed Pi binary remains cryptographically verified and unmodified.

heading: AGY Swarm Roles & Model Tiers
content: Master Architect (Pro) decides and synthesizes. Researcher (Flash, read-only) discovers. Builder (Flash) implements RED->GREEN. Tester (Flash) verifies. Reviewer (Flash) audits.

heading: Operating Principle: Flash Explores, Pro Decides
content: Flash workers gather facts and execute bounded tasks. Master reasons on architecture. Escalate individual difficult tasks to Pro, not the entire swarm.

heading: Global STOP Conditions
content: Workers must STOP when: architectural seam missing on disk, mutation boundary exceeded, teardown unprovable, hypothesis treated as fact, or outer invariants compromised.

heading: Three Subscription Quota Pools
content: ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo): Premium control lane for architecture and review. Google AI Pro ($19.99/mo): High-volume worker lane. OpenCode Go ($10/mo): Cheap parallel swarm lane.

heading: Accepted Steps per Quota Metric
content: Optimization metric is accepted engineering steps per exhausted quota pool, not raw API request count. Prune prompts under 2,000 tokens with exact target line numbers.

heading: DeepHar / Cordis Plugin Lab Layout
content: Isolated staging in tries/deepseek-harness-lab allows testing, inspecting, and rejecting plugins with mock effects before promoting to Dream OS.

heading: QuickShell Aesthetic Design Iteration
content: Desktop UI customizations in technopagan-netrunner follow single-variable bounded visual iterations with before/after regression checks.

heading: Epistemic Tagging Taxonomy
content: Every claim is tagged: SOURCE_DERIVED (literature), DESIGN_DECISION (accepted architecture), HYPOTHESIS (unproven idea), EXPERIMENT (probe), OBSERVED (run measurement), CONFIRMED (audited).

heading: Testing Reality Levels
content: STATIC (lint/types), SIMULATED (mock double), INTEGRATION (real SDK contract), LIVE_OBSERVED (installed system binary). Mock Pi is SIMULATED, not INTEGRATION.

heading: Append-Only Causal Journaling
content: Consequential executions log immutable entries with causationId, correlationId, monotonic timestamps, component hashes, and before/after state diff hashes.
